name: wp-lenta9may
author: Bahus

sections.description:
The ribbon is displayed automatically in the top left corner from April 25th to May 12th. The rest of the time, the ribbon remains completely hidden.

Upon clicking, an interactive popup appears, allowing users to visit official remembrance websites in a new tab.

P.S. This plugin was built and redesigned based on the old wp-GeorgLenta plugin, which was closed in late 2018 and is no longer available for download.

If you like this plugin, please consider leaving a 5-star rating!
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. That’s it!
